title: Inspect, retry and cancel jobs; read the queues
caption: A migrate to an unknown version is the quickest way to get a failed job on purpose (admin-tenant-lifecycle.e2e.ts).

steps.title: Make a failing migrate job
steps.body: Type `9999_not_in_this_release` in **Target version (optional)**, press **Migrate**, confirm **Start migration**.
steps.expect: 'The migrate job is on its way to the OTA worker.' with a Migration job link.

steps.title: Read the job
steps.body: Open the link; reload until the status changes.
steps.expect: Status Failed with `UNKNOWN_TARGET_VERSION: No tenant migration of this release has the target version …`; BullMQ job `<jobId>-<n>` on `ota-tenant-ops`; OTA status unchanged.

steps.title: Retry or cancel
steps.body: **Retry** on a failed job (confirm); **Cancel job** with a reason on a queued one.
steps.expect: Retry answers with a **new** job (link); the failed one stays. Cancel → `canceled`. Running/succeeded/canceled jobs offer neither.

steps.title: Queues
steps.body: Two tables: Platform queues and OTA queues; open `ota-tenant-ops`.
steps.expect: Waiting/active/delayed/failed counts and oldest wait in words; the OTA queue says 'OTA queue, view only' and has no Retry; the failed attempt links its provisioning job.

steps.title: Retry a platform queue job
steps.body: On a `platform-*` queue with failures, **Retry** a job (confirm).
steps.expect: Job back to waiting; the row disappears on reload; audit `queue_job.retried`.
